title: Classified paper comparing human and ET psychic ability that disappeared

tellings.quote: I was tasked to do a paper that as soon as I turned it in, it disappeared.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who served in a military unit that trained people to describe distant places using only the mind, says that in the 1980s he was told to write a paper comparing human psychic ability with that of aliens. He tells it first-hand and says that as soon as he turned the paper in, it disappeared. If true, it would mean someone in the military was treating alien psychic ability as a real subject to study.
